people.name: Prashant Verma
people.bio: Prashant Verma is the Chief Information Security Officer of Bajaj Finance Ltd since February 1, 2024. Prashant Verma has around 21 years of full-time experience on Security Domain. He joined us as head of Cyber Risk Unit 7 years back and is now heading Information Security. In his previous job, he has architected security services and has worked as security auditor and consultant for various domestic and international banks and insurance companies. He is CISSP and is co-author of couple of security books.
